nodes.label: Correlation as a lever on the five tightest decided margins
nodes.rationale: Explicitly NOT a bound on the correlation error: position S93 section 4 route (i) misnamed the SOSEX spec, which is a gas-derived functional rather than a second-order expansion in the field's own orbitals. A true second-order-in-orbitals bound is left as a separate build (V5).

nodes.label: Correlation forms Z (GB high-density), R (ring), S (ring+screened SOX)
nodes.rationale: All three in-project with PZ-SIC as in hfc2.corr_pot and no new constant, so form-spread measures the field rather than a library choice; C5 makes the effect's form-independence to 30% the condition under which any gas-derived functional may speak to criterion 3.

nodes.label: C4: l-signed margin shift (widens at d rows, narrows at s rows)
nodes.rationale: Filed as sign-exact at 72/89/105 positive and 38/56 negative; later recorded as falsified in s95, which names it a gas-functional l-rule and a different object from the core-valence pair-energy statement.

nodes.label: C6 shape: |Delta_m|/m largest at the smallest margin
nodes.rationale: Scored loosely on purpose: if 89 or 105 differs from 72 by more than 3x, correlation is carrying a mechanism tied to the collapse rows - a residue pointing at an unnamed law rather than a smooth field property.
